newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU fines Italian, Spanish, Greek milk producers.
newsitem.headline: EU fines Italian, Spanish, Greek milk producers.

text.p: The European Commission on Thursday decided to withhold farm funds from Italy, Spain and Greece for failing to pay so-called super levy fines totalling 240 million Ecus for exceeding 1995/96 (April/March) milk output quotas.
Italian farmers were fined 192.2 million Ecus, Spanish farmers 45.3 million and Greek farmers 2.66 million.
"It is imperative for stability in the milk sector that milk producers respect their quota," EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said in a statement.
Italy and Greece have already made partial payments but Spain has not made any.
For Italy, the outstanding amount will be withheld over three months at the rate of 108.2 billion lire per month. For Greece 514.6 million drachmas will be withheld in a single instalment.
For Spain, the amount will be withheld over two months at the rate of 3.6 billion pesetas per month.
The money will be withheld from payments due under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP)
